alert: the gateway is returning 504 Gateway Timeout errors on GET /orders
note: Rebuilt from stored benchmark results (evals/results/db-pool-exhaustion.json, session 2026-10-28T00:32:19.206Z, agent run 1). The agent's text, its thinking and the tool outputs were not recorded. This run predates the per-turn trace, so its turns and tool calls are not available. The report, citations and verification are the stored originals.

report.summary: The gateway returns 504 on GET /orders because order-service's Postgres connection pool (max 10) is exhausted. The `/orders/leaky` endpoint checks out a client on every call and never releases it, so `/orders` requests queue for a connection and hit the gateway's 3s timeout.
report.root_cause: The `GET /orders/leaky` handler in order-service (src/index.ts, present since the initial commit bbac411) calls `pool.connect()` and never calls `client.release()`. Each hit permanently leaks one of the 10 pooled connections. After about 10 calls the pool is saturated (total=10 idle=0 waiting=5), and `GET /orders` blocks on `pool.connect()` until the gateway's 3s timeout produces a 504. Postgres is healthy and the order-service container is not resource-constrained, so the fault is the connection leak in the application code.

evidence.verbatim_quote: [orders/leaky] acquired client, will not release (total=10 idle=0 waiting=5)

+  await client.query("SELECT 1");
+  res.json({ ok: true, leaked: true });
